violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: A certified food manager was not present during the inspection
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER MUST BE PRESENT AT ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. HAVE MULTIPLE EMPLOYEES BECOME CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGERS. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The hot water at the hand washing sink by the kitchen door was observed at 0f. Water was turned off at this sink.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. THE HOT WATER AT THE HAND SINK BY THE BATHROOM WAS OBSERVED AT 110f. ENSURE ALL HAND SINKS ARE TURNED ON TO FACILITATE PROPER HAND WASHING.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: There was no paper towels in the paper towel dispensers at the two handsinks in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC PLACED PAPER TOWELS AT THESE HAND SINK. ENSURE ALL HAND SINK HAVE PAPER TOWELS TO FACILITATE PROPER HAND WASHING. EMPANADAS DE MENDOZA (Inspection Date: 05/22/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) jarred chimichurri sauce with garlic designated retail sale
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE JARRED CHIMICHURRI SAUCE. ENSURE CHIMICHURRI SAUCE IS REFRIGERATED AT 41f OR LOWER.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: 1) jarred chimichurri sauce with garlic designated for retail sale
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC DISCARDED THE CHIMICHURRI SAUCE. ENSURE CHIMICHURRI SAUCE FOR RETAIL SALE HAS A DATE MARKING.

violations.title: Food Packaged, Labeled per Law
violations.observation: Observed jarred chimichurri sauce for retail sale without appropriate labeling.
violations.corrective_action: Food packaged in a food establishment shall be labeled as specified in Law including 21 CFR 101 - Food labeling, and 9 CFR 317 Labeling, marking devices, and containers. LABEL ALL JARRED CHIMICHURRI SAUCE FOR RETAIL SALE WITH THE INGREDIENTS.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers of bulk dried spices were observed reused for the storage of chimichurri sauce
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. DO NOT REUSED THE BULK SPICE CONTAINERS TO STORE CHIMICHURRI SUACE. USE NSF APPROVED FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Hand sink by the kitchen door was not functioning at the time of the inspection
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. ENSURE THE HAND SINK BY THE KITCHEN DOOR IS FUNCTIONING TO FACILITATE PROPER HAND WASHING.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed staff change gloves without washing hands
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO WASH HANDS BEFORE PUTTING ON NEW GLOVES.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) chimichurri sauce containing garlic was observed at 51f. Individually portioned chimichurri sauces were observed in a container on top of the microwave. Upon discussion with PIC, sauces were put out less than 1 hour prior to the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC PUT ALL THE SAUCES INTO THE 2DR UPRIGHT NEXT TO THE OVEN.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: Observed no consumer advisory on the digital menu for the medium cooked/fried egg. Egg is served with the Lomito, the Burger, and Napolitano sandwich.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO PLACE A CONSUMER ADVISORY ASTERISK * NEXT TO EGG ON THE MENU. ADDITIONALLY, INCLUDE A DISCLOSURE AND REMINDER STATEMENT ON THE MENU. SEE FAIRFAX COUNTY CONSUMER ADVISORY WEBSITE FOR ADDITIONAL GUIDANCE. PLEASE CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed mop heads in the mop sink basin.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. EMPANADAS DE MENDOZA (Inspection Date: 11/24/2025) Page 2 of 3
